scientific.integrity: The arbitrary-n proof uses a complete first-force case split in the cubic triangle-free prism, proves all four surviving local configurations force, and counts them without overlap. The packaged checker reconstructs the graph process directly and independently tests the classification on finite instances.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to circular ladders Y_n for n at least 5; the smaller prisms have exceptional minimum-set profiles.
The exhaustive checker covers n=5 through 11 only; the all-n result rests on the symbolic local case analysis.
The result classifies minimum zero forcing sets, not all zero forcing sets and not the full reconfiguration graph.
An unindexed source under alternate prism notation may exist, so bibliographic residual risk is not zero.
